#!/bin/sh
# runs the program against the stand-in host; "@calls" prints what the host was asked (never the token)
D="$HOME/../fakehost"
for a in "$@"; do if [ "$a" = "@calls" ]; then cat "$D/calls.log" 2>/dev/null; exit 0; fi; done
KITH_SERVE_DIR="$D" KITH_SERVE_PORT="$(cat "$D/port")" exec "$@"

run: python3 "$HOME/../fakehost/server.py" "$HOME/../fakehost" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & i=0; while [ ! -s "$HOME/../fakehost/port" ] && [ $i -lt 200 ]; do sleep 0.05; i=$((i+1)); done; test -s "$HOME/../fakehost/port"
